subject.text: Congratulations! You won a new phone

body.text: Your number was chosen in our Year-End Lucky Draw.
To claim your prize, enter your full name, NIK, and bank account number in the form below:

explanation: You never joined this lucky draw, and the message asks for your NIK and bank account number through a form. That is a classic sign of phishing, so block it.
hints: Has any of our employees ever joined this lucky draw?
Look at what data it asks for. Should anyone ask for that through a form in an email?
